home.what: What do you want to do?
home.action.mass: Type the sequence, apply modifications and see monoisotopic and average mass, formula, charge states and isotopic envelope.
home.action.fragments: a/b/c/x/y/z series with neutral losses and multiple charges, matching against an m/z list and export (CSV, Excel, PDF, Skyline).
home.action.experimental: Open an mzML, mzXML or .raw file, pick the scan on the chromatogram and annotate the spectrum with score and identification criteria.
home.action.library: Register non-natural amino acids and modifications by formula, with PubChem search.
home.saved_help: Click a name to open it on the Mass screen.
